depth_history.shortcut_targeted: The assumption that an answer can be obtained by selecting users from a single bipartition camp, without solving for a potentially larger independent set that mixes the camps.
depth_history.edit_summary: Add an explicit clarification immediately after the camp guarantee: "Do not assume that a valid group lies within one camp. A required group may use users from both camps, and it can exist even when neither camp alone contains k users."

resistant_to: Bipartitions the graph and treats one entire camp, typically the larger one, as the candidate maximum all-strangers group.
